notes.title: Early Preview of Flirting Features and Interactions
notes.content:
Howdy all, 

We’ve got something fun to share! Here’s an early look at two features we’re working on. First up is the flirting feature, with a work-in-progress animation that sets the mood. Then, we’re showcasing two interaction poses, giving you a little taste of how characters will express themselves and connect with the charming residents. Both are still in development, and we’re excited to keep refining and expanding them as the game continues to take shape.

notes.title: Core Romance Vote Results and Pajamas Reveal
notes.content:
[h3]Howdy all,[/h3]
[h2]The Core Romanceable Characters and Old Friends Revisit Votes Are In![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45205347/218da9005e4d6e8ef9cf4fe75548b30e95744676.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45205347/f133ced1e3fed00e268adee372005233e556164b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45205347/c3cd3bdcb8607f1cbe36c1d2c2c716c836ba5ff6.png[/img]

[h3]So, Who made the cut?[/h3]
Thanks to your amazing support, each of our core romanceable characters now has their very own unique pajama look, thoughtfully designed to match their personality. Whether it’s playful, cozy, or sleek, you’ll get to see these characters like never before, ready for those heartwarming, cozy nights.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45205347/955c17b142b7ddd629dd668d52ff69c1bf1926b3.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45205347/fba978c0f993705ffc95b71b00b7234c00f2d966.jpg[/img]

We hope you love seeing them in a whole new light, all set for some intimate and relaxing moments together.

But we’re not stopping there!
We’d love to hear from you, who’s pajama look is your favorite? Let us know in the comments.

And of course, don’t forget, we’re building a new home together in Evershine. Let’s keep those vibes flowing as we move closer to bringing this vision to life!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3199500/My_Time_at_Evershine/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45205347/ef248e8e6b5b4d43b1162b473ee36159c34a6f75.png[/img][/url]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3199500/

notes.title: A few hours left! And Player Body Customization Concept Check!
notes.content:
Howdy, 

We hit the $2M stretch goal a few days ago, unlocking Player Body Customization, and now we’ve got a special treat for you—a sneak peek at the first concept GIF! Whether you’re aiming for a bulkier build or a stronger chest, the choice is all yours. This is just the beginning, with more customization options on the way!

With only a few hours left, let’s make one final push to unlock another core romanceable at $2.75 million. Every bit helps, and together, we can go even higher!📈 🚀

notes.title: 72 Hours Left! Devs Talk Kickstarter—On to 2.5M!
notes.content:
[h3]Howdy, [/h3]

We’ve been reflecting on how much your support means to us, so we sat down with the team to chat about their Kickstarter experiences. Some are shy, but everyone is excited to share how your support is shaping the game and what’s coming next. It’s a fun, behind-the-scenes look, filled with plenty of laughs and appreciation!

Watch the video below to join the conversation! 📺

[previewyoutube=P6UOItANedQ;full][/previewyoutube]

With just 72 hours left, we’ve hit the 2.25M milestone! Next up is the optional Rival Romance feature for non-core characters, and we’re nearing 2.5M, which means we’ll skip Steam Early Access. By moving straight to Alpha testing with you, we can focus on polishing the game, ensuring a smoother development schedule and a more enjoyable full launch experience for everyone! [[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/666140/announcements/detail/6493719016526096167/]Read more about it here[/url]]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45205347/0c38df0c2dd6675a1159f44fe6b804467d227940.jpg[/img]

Please help spread the word—we’re so close to making this a reality together!

[b][h1][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/mtae/my-time-at-evershine-the-next-my-time-tale][Evershine KS PAGE][/url][/h1][/b]

notes.title: The new features we’ve unlocked so far!
notes.content:
[h3]Howdy, Governors![/h3]

We’ve got just [b]10 days[/b] left for Kickstarter, and thanks to our incredible backers, we’ve already unlocked some fantastic features for all future governors! Take a sneak peek below, and we could unlock even more! Click the link below to join us on this journey!

[b][h1][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/mtae/my-time-at-evershine-the-next-my-time-tale][Evershine KS PAGE][/url][/h1][/b]
[h3]Backer T-shirt[/h3]
Our character is decked out in the exclusive Kickstarter T-shirt.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45205347/5bbf5b488eb0700370b46d1097f12926adfb87ec.jpg[/img]

[h3]Flirting Feature[/h3]
This is an early look at the flirting feature. The content and dialogue options might change in the final game. For now, we just have this animation in place, and the full functionality will be added gradually as development continues.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45205347/0e75d685fa5a3246840815b528ed9ef8d0dd4e11.gif[/img]
[h3]Bathtub[/h3]
Relax and recharge in style with this bathtub set—an ultimate escape for you or your favorite NPCs, each enjoying their own peaceful retreat after a long day of adventuring!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45205347/98dc137eca4bf9815b44e17680e491a8fc16ced9.jpg[/img]
[h3]Player-Voted Interaction[/h3]
We’ve got three interactions lined up—now it’s your turn to add one you love! Be ready to throw your ideas our way! Heck, you can start preparing them now!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45205347/26e02a5b477171445d7dc927edf5c4c43093e213.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45205347/3e0d22df995605de4ff7773a8384aab9ce57a0bd.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45205347/f6015256e3bac499ce8a1fee03ea2afa8b1b71a2.png[/img]
[h3]Vote on Portia/Sandrock Character Visit[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45205347/73dbab90aa8aa4f1a6b27ba040c94dd074e8b233.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45205347/b41de724df724dc383cefa3353dc5c7eaf3019a8.png[/img]
[h3]Swimming feature[/h3]
Below is a concept shot of the swimming feature. Our animation team posed the main character and Ragnar, then tossed them into the water to create this mock-up. There's still a lot to do for the actual in-game swimming—like fine-tuning the camera, player controls, stamina management, ...and the tricky part: making sure the NPCs know how to swim properly alongside you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45205347/e40e03e154890857442f494c6a70850ddb986846.png[/img]
[h3]Hot Spring Play/Date
[/h3]
Still remember the hot spring mini-game in Portia? Everyone was chilling in the hot springs fully clothed—haha, a bit awkward, right? So, does this new concept look a bit more... fitting? Got any fun ideas to make the hot spring mini-game even better?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45205347/ee1dbbc2594c694017c026efb77c1b69fbaf9f26.png[/img]
[h3]Player-Designed Special Pet[/h3]
Below are early-stage demonstrations of the pet, provided for your design reference:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45205347/46135dda60261527812da79c48b4171247675279.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45205347/af50d4cd0f467626ca81380153002620d5617830.gif[/img]
[h3]Pajama Party![/h3]
Our core romanceable characters are set to relax in their cozy new pajamas! As shown in the concept art, they’ll be lounging in stylish sleepwear, automatically switching into them at bedtime. Of course, if you love their pajama look, you can keep them in it all day long—it’s totally up to you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45205347/522b1631ae140ecbe79b05bbf6d10f0738208503.jpg[/img]
[h3]10 New Photo Poses[/h3]
Here are the references—now we can’t wait to see what you design next!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45205347/97fca3081e94ff7fef4087951b5c8d55c3d3d63b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45205347/471579c1f5894f6b663ffb1aaa9ec9d6ee1768b9.jpg[/img]
[h3]Logan and your past will be visiting MTAE[/h3]
Some stories will unfold.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45205347/2036a70c845bafa5ed35b1dbd83dc123964b6332.jpg[/img]

And with the help of our backers, '[b]Adjustable Height[/b],' '[b][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/mtae/my-time-at-evershine-the-next-my-time-tale/posts/4208025]One More Romanceable Character[/url][/b],' and '[b]Player Body Customization[/b]' have also been unlocked! 

There are even more exciting features to unlock in the last 10 days! Head to the page below and see how we can make this new home even better together.

[b][h1][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/mtae/my-time-at-evershine-the-next-my-time-tale][Evershine KS PAGE][/url][/h1][/b]
